def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    obj=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    # The blank rectangular target is filled with a horizontal reflection of the object.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    zeros=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==0]
    tr0,tr1=min(r for r,c in zeros),max(r for r,c in zeros)
    tc0,tc1=min(c for r,c in zeros),max(c for r,c in zeros)
    flipped=[row[::-1] for row in obj]
    for i in range(tr1-tr0+1):
        for j in range(tc1-tc0+1):
            out[tr0+i][tc0+j]=flipped[i][j]
    return out
